lyrics:
[Intro: funky rhythm guitar, four-on-the-floor kick, talkbox lick]

[Verse 1: cool male voice, rhythmic]
Bad news on the left, bad news on the right
Group chat's on fire, can't sleep at night
Everybody's shouting, everybody's sure
I'm just trying to make it to the door

[Pre-Chorus: building, falsetto]
Then right there in the middle of the mess
Somebody pulled a chair out, said, "Sit. Rest."

[Chorus: full disco groove, strings, falsetto stacks]
You set a table (ooh) in the middle of it all
Candles lit (ooh) with my back against the wall
Trouble at the window, trouble at the gate
You just smile and you fill my plate
My cup's running over on the floor
You set a table. I'm not scared anymore.

[Verse 2: voice lower, bass leading]
Old song by a shepherd boy, three thousand years
About a Shepherd walking with him through his fears
Then the Shepherd came himself, in sandals and dust
Set a table with his friends the night before the cross

[Pre-Chorus: building, falsetto]
Bread and a cup and "remember me"
And a seat with my name. I can't believe.

[Chorus: full disco groove, strings, falsetto stacks]
You set a table (ooh) in the middle of it all
Candles lit (ooh) with my back against the wall
Trouble at the window, trouble at the gate
You just smile and you fill my plate
My cup's running over on the floor
You set a table. I'm not scared anymore.

[Bridge: breakdown, bass and claps, chant]
Goodness (following me!)
Mercy (following me!)
All my days (following me!)
Jesus (leading me!)

[Final Chorus: everything in, horns on top]
You set a table (ooh) in the middle of it all
Candles lit (ooh) with my back against the wall
Trouble at the window, trouble at the gate
You just smile and you fill my plate
My cup's running over on the floor
Jesus set a table. I'm not scared anymore.

[Outro: guitar, glasses clinking, laughter]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 112 BPM, 4/4, F minor. A sleek disco-funk strut that is impossible to sit still to.

VOICE: Male, cool and rhythmic in the verses, nearly spoken. The pre-chorus and chorus go up into stacked falsetto. A group shouts the answers in the bridge. A talkbox doubles a few phrases.

INSTRUMENTS: A tight, muted funk rhythm guitar, a four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats, a syncopated slap bass, disco strings, a talkbox lead, electric piano, handclaps, a horn section in the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar, kick and talkbox. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:28 Pre-chorus. 0:36 Chorus 1. 1:06 Verse 2, the shepherd. 1:24 Pre-chorus, the supper. 1:32 Chorus 2. 2:02 Bridge, chant. 2:20 Final chorus with horns. 2:50 Outro, guitar, glasses and laughter, ends 3:12.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Modern nu-disco: polished, tight and bright, bass and kick locked, strings wide.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The bridge chant at 2:02, ending 'Jesus (leading me!)'.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus are someone making a calm place in a chaotic day. Verse 2 at 1:06 points to Psalm 23 and then to the Last Supper, and the bridge finishes the psalm with the name.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Frazzled, surprised, calm, dancing.
